caption.en: The title page of the sisters' Song Stories for the Kindergarten in its revised edition of 1896, crediting the music to Mildred J. Hill and the words to Patty S. Hill.
caption.es: Portada de Song Stories for the Kindergarten, de las hermanas, en su edición revisada de 1896, que atribuye la música a Mildred J. Hill y la letra a Patty S. Hill.

source: Song Stories for the Kindergarten, New Edition, Revised, Illustrated and Enlarged, by Mildred J. Hill and Patty S. Hill (Chicago: Clayton F. Summy Co., copyright 1896), title page

alt.en: A page of printed music numbered 3, headed "Good-Morning to All.", with "To be sung standing." and "Brightly." above the first staff. A voice line in 3/4 time with the words "Good-morning to you, Good-morning to you, Good-morning dear children, Good-morning to all." runs over a two-staff piano part, in two systems.
alt.es: Página de música impresa con el número 3 y el título "Good-Morning to All.", con "To be sung standing." y "Brightly." sobre el primer pentagrama. Una línea de canto en 3/4 con la letra "Good-morning to you, Good-morning to you, Good-morning dear children, Good-morning to all." va sobre una parte de piano de dos pentagramas, en dos sistemas.

caption.en: Good-Morning to All, the first song in the 1896 Song Stories for the Kindergarten: the tune the world now sings as Happy Birthday to You, with the sisters' classroom greeting.
caption.es: Good-Morning to All, la primera canción de Song Stories for the Kindergarten de 1896: la melodía que hoy el mundo canta como Happy Birthday to You, con el saludo de clase de las hermanas.

source: Song Stories for the Kindergarten, New Edition, Revised, Illustrated and Enlarged, by Mildred J. Hill and Patty S. Hill (Chicago: Clayton F. Summy Co., copyright 1896), p. 3, "Good-Morning to All" (top half of the page)
